title: Jewelry Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Sonar Sansar is a heritage jewellery brand built on over 70 years of craftsmanship and three generations of business innovation. Originating from the inspiring journey of its founder, Mr. Tarak Chandra Paul, the company has grown from a small gold artisan workshop into a trusted manufacturer and retailer for customers across eastern India and PAN India. Sonar Sansar operates a 1,500 sq ft flagship showroom in Bandhaghat, Howrah, offering finely crafted gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including both ready-made and custom designs. With in-house manufacturing, the brand provides high-quality pieces at fair prices, supported by honest practices, transparency, and a strong after-sales relationship focus. The culture emphasizes growth for customers, partners, and employees, making it a compelling workplace for individuals who value integrity and long-term development.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Jewelry Salesperson role based in Haora. The Jewelry Salesperson will welcome customers, understand their needs, and provide personalized guidance on gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including ready-made and custom designs. Daily responsibilities include explaining product features and pricing, presenting collections, handling inquiries, and offering recommendations that align with customer preferences and budgets. The role involves completing sales transactions, managing billing and documentation, maintaining displays and stock presentation, and supporting visual merchandising standards. The Jewelry Salesperson will also build long-term customer relationships, support after-sales service, coordinate with the manufacturing and back-office teams, and contribute to achieving showroom sales targets.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Retail Sales and Sales skills, with experience meeting or exceeding targets in a showroom or store environment.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service and Communication skills to engage customers respectfully, understand their needs, and build lasting relationships.
* Candidates should possess solid Product Knowledge related to jewellery (gold, diamond, silver), including basic understanding of purity, certification, design types, and current market trends.
* Basic numeracy and comfort with billing systems or POS tools; ability to handle cash, cards, and digital payments accurately.
* Prior experience in jewellery or luxury retail is highly beneficial, though candidates with strong sales and customer service backgrounds from other retail sectors are also encouraged to apply.
* Ability to work on-site in Haora, including weekends and peak festive seasons, with a professional appearance and ethical conduct.
* Minimum educational qualification: high school diploma; additional training in retail, sales, or jewellery design is an advantage.

title: Computer Numerical Control Machine Operator
description:
**Company Description**
BR TECHNICAL SERVICES is a manufacturing and engineering services company specializing in precision machining and component production for a range of industrial clients. The company focuses on reliable, high-quality output using modern machinery and established production processes. Team members work with standardized procedures and safety practices to deliver consistent results. BR TECHNICAL SERVICES values technical skill, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement in its operations.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Machine Operator role based in Howrah. The CNC Machine Operator will set up, operate, and monitor CNC machines to produce parts according to drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Daily tasks include interpreting technical drawings, selecting tools, loading materials, adjusting machine settings, and performing basic program edits as needed. The role involves measuring and inspecting finished components, documenting results, and working with the production team to maintain workflow, minimize downtime, and meet delivery targets. The operator will follow all safety guidelines, maintain a clean work area, and report equipment issues promptly.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Machine Operation skills, including setup, monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of CNC equipment.
* Experience in Machining and Milling, with the ability to work from technical drawings and use appropriate tools and cutting parameters.
* Capability in Quality Control, including dimensional inspection, use of measuring instruments (calipers, micrometers, gauges), and adherence to tolerance requirements.
* Familiarity with industrial Machinery and safe operating practices within a production or workshop environment.
* Foundational knowledge of CNC programming or program adjustment is an advantage.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and production documentation.
* Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a focus on safety and precision.
* Previous experience as a CNC operator or machinist in a manufacturing setting preferred.
* Relevant technical or vocational training in machining or mechanical engineering is beneficial.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
**Key Responsibilities :-**

1. Garment Quality Inspection

* Inspect garments at different stages of production, including cutting, stitching, finishing, and packing.
* Conduct inline, midline, end-line, and final garment inspections.
* Check garments for stitching defects, measurement deviations, fabric defects, stains, shade variations, and finishing issues.
* Ensure garments conform to approved samples, buyer specifications, size charts, and quality standards.
* Inspect finished garments for workmanship, appearance, fitting, and overall quality.

2. Fabric & Accessories Inspection

* Inspect fabric, trims, and accessories for defects before and during production.
* Check fabric quality, shade variation, shrinkage, color consistency, and other relevant parameters.
* Verify labels, tags, buttons, zippers, prints, embroidery, and other garment components against approved specifications.
* Report defective materials and coordinate with the concerned departments for corrective action.

3. Measurement & Technical Quality

* Conduct garment measurement checks according to approved size specifications and measurement charts.
* Verify tolerances and ensure compliance with buyer-specific quality requirements.
* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure adherence to approved samples, construction details, and workmanship standards.

4. Production Quality Monitoring

* Monitor production processes to identify and prevent quality issues at an early stage.
* Coordinate with production supervisors, line in-charges, and stitching operators to resolve defects.
* Conduct re-inspections after corrective actions have been implemented.
* Ensure rejected or defective garments are segregated and properly identified.
* Support the production team in reducing rejection rates, rework, and material wastage.

5. Final Inspection & Packing

* Conduct final inspection of finished garments before dispatch or shipment.
* Check garment appearance, measurements, labeling, folding, packing, and carton details.
* Verify packing instructions and buyer-specific requirements.
* Ensure the required quality checks are completed before goods are approved for dispatch.
* Assist during buyer inspections and third-party quality inspections, as required.

6. Quality Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain inspection reports, defect records, measurement reports, and rejection data.
* Prepare daily quality reports and communicate major quality issues to the reporting manager.
* Track defect rates and identify recurring problems.
* Maintain records of corrective actions and follow up to ensure implementation.
* Support quality audits and maintain relevant inspection documentation.

7. Compliance & Quality Standards

* Ensure compliance with company quality procedures and applicable buyer quality standards.
* Follow approved inspection procedures and sampling plans, where applicable.
* Maintain proper segregation and traceability of rejected and approved goods.
* Support internal, buyer, and third-party quality audits.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Knowledge of garment construction, stitching operations, finishing, and garment manufacturing processes.
* Ability to identify garment defects and assess workmanship quality.
* Knowledge of garment measurement charts, size specifications, and tolerances.
* Understanding of inline, end-line, and final inspection procedures.
* Familiarity with buyer quality standards and AQL-based inspection methods.
* Good observation, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate with production and quality teams.
* Basic computer skills for maintaining quality records and inspection reports.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Previous experience as a Quality Controller, Quality Inspector, or Garment Quality Checker in a garment manufacturing unit or export house.
* Practical knowledge of woven and/or knitted garment inspection, depending on the company's product range.
* Experience handling buyer inspections and export-quality requirements will be an advantage.
* Ability to identify defects, maintain quality standards, and support timely production and shipment.

description:

**Job Title: Maintenance Tech I**
**Department: Public Works**
**FLSA Status: Non-Exempt**
**Position Status: Full-time**
**Salary: $20.09**
**Job Physical Level: Strenuous**
**GENERAL PURPOSE**
Performs unskilled and skilled work in the operation and maintenance of streets, bridges, parks, natural areas and recreation areas to maintain a beautiful, safe and welcoming environment for the community of Trinidad and its visitors.
  
  
**CULTURAL VALUES AND COMPETENCIES**
The mission of every employee at the City of Trinidad is to deliver exceptional value and quality of life to all our citizens. Each employee is measured by the ability to adhere to the city’s core value of Pride which is delivered through Purpose, Responsibility, Integrity, Dependability and Excellence. As a City, we embrace and celebrate diversity and equity for all citizens and recognize that it is a privilege to serve the citizens of Trinidad, Colorado.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*The following statements are illustrative of the essential functions of the job and do not include other nonessential or peripheral duties that may be required. The City of Trinidad retains the right to modify or change the essential duties and additional functions of the job at any time without notice. Examples of duties are not intended to be all-inclusive or restrictive. Responsibilities as outlined in the City Charter:*
**Note**
:
**Regular and predictable attendance in the performance of this job is an essential function.**

* Performs minor maintenance of trucks and equipment, such as greasing, washing and checking oil and tires.
* Responsible for street repairs and maintenance, including surface restoration, sign installation and repair, and painting traffic lines.
* Keeps public grounds clear and safe, including mowing grass, picking up debris and trash, and removing snow and ice during hazardous weather conditions.
* Maintains streets, storm drains, catch basins, parks and other public areas.
* Provides trash removal for City owned properties such as park spaces and recreation areas.
* Trims trees, removes brush and chips remaining wood.
* Maintains and cleans public restrooms, performs minor repairs on fixtures.
* Provides maintenance and repair of irrigation systems on sports fields and special plantings.
* Performs plowing, blowing and hauling of snow; sanding and salting of roadways
* Flushes and cleans manholes, catch basins, storm sewer, and storm sewer pipelines.
* Maintains ditches and natural water courses.
* Loads, hauls, and stockpiles sand, gravel, brush, and other materials.
* Maintains a safe work area by setting up barricades, warning devices, and proper vehicle/equipment placement.
* Maintains records of work performed.
* Performs tasks using hand tools, as required.
* Participates in “on-call” program and responds to emergency call outs.
* Performs building maintenance as assigned.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge Of**
**NECESSARY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Or the ability to learn the geography and streets of the City and locations of public areas.
* Knowledge of safety laws and regulations and the occupational hazards and safety precautions necessary to the operation of heavy trucks and equipment.

**Skilled In**

* Safe work record and demonstration of a strong work ethic.
* Strong organizational skills and a willingness to be pro-active and accept new challenges.
* Building effective teams and providing efficient customer service.

**Ability To**

* Listen to, read, understand and communicate the English language so that others are able to understand. This must be done both orally and in writing, at the level appropriate for the position held.
* Understand and carry out oral and written instructions.
* Professionally handle public complaints and requests.
* Accept personal responsibility for one’s decisions.
* Maintain effective working relations with co-workers.
* Reliably and predictably carry out duties.

**SUPERVISION**
**Received:**
Works under the general supervision of the Department Foreman and the Public Works Director.
  
  
**Exercised:**
None.
  
  
**Job Qualifications**
**Required Education/Experience:**

* High School diploma or equivalent.
* Labor experience preferred.

**Other Requirements**

* Must possess a valid current state-issued driver’s license and not be under suspension, revocation or denial nor have any prior alcohol and/or drug related driving offenses within the last five years. A driving record search will be conducted on all applicants prior to employment and will be subject to observation throughout their employment.
* Must possess a Class “B” Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or obtain it within six (6) months of date of hire at the applicant’s expense.
* Successful candidates must pass a background investigation and physical examination in accordance with job duties prior to employment.
* Applicants will be required to undergo drug testing prior to employment and may be subject to further drug and alcohol testing throughout their employment as per City policy
* CPR/First Aid training required. All certifications, once achieved, must be maintained throughout employment.

**TOOLS & EQUIPMENT USED**
Must be able to operate equipment typical to the trade such as dump truck, pickup truck, utility truck, backhoe, snowplow, street sweeper, tamper, mowers, compressors, sanders, generators, common hand and power tools, shovels, wrenches, detection devices, mobile radio, phone.
  
  
**WORKING CONDITIONS**
*The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*
Tasks involve the ability to exert physical effort in moderate to intense work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, shoveling, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 100 pounds). The majority of a normal workday involves standing or walking.
  
  
Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discern colors or shades of colors. Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discern sounds or odors. Some tasks require depth perception or the ability to perceive and discern textures. Some tasks require visual perception and discrimination.
  
  
Tasks are regularly performed with exposure to adverse environmental conditions including, but not limited to, dirt, dust, pollen, odors, wetness, humidity, rain, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, and toxic agents.
  
  
The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.
  
  
To apply, send a completed City of Trinidad application to HR@trinidad.co.gov.

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde South Asia Services Pvt. Ltd. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

 Are you an experienced equipment operator with a strong commitment to public service and municipal operations? The RM of West St. Paul is seeking a skilled and safety\-conscious Equipment Operator II to support the maintenance and repair of municipal infrastructure and provide essential public works services to our growing community.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As an Equipment Operator II, you will operate and maintain a variety of heavy and light equipment while supporting the delivery of municipal public works services throughout the RM. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Operate graders, front\-end loaders, sanding/plow trucks, and snow blowers.
* Perform road maintenance, including pothole patching, grading, gravel repair, and dust control.
* Conduct snow plowing and sanding of roads, pathways, and parking lots.
* Install and maintain traffic and information signage in accordance with applicable standards.
* Support waste and recycling programs, including roll\-out bin delivery and maintenance.
* Respond to emergency callouts and assist with infrastructure maintenance projects.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Grade 12 education or equivalent.
* Minimum 5 years of experience operating and maintaining heavy equipment, including motor graders.
* Valid Manitoba Class 3 Driver's License with Air Brake Endorsement (Class 1 considered an asset).
* Experience in municipal public works, construction, or a related field.
* Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of WHMIS requirements and safe equipment operation practices.
* Physically capable of performing manual labour and working outdoors in varying weather conditions

title: Shift In-charge - Power Plant
description:
**Shift In\-Charge – Power Plant** 




**Company:** 
 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Power Generation / Captive Power Plant
 



**Location:** 
 Jharkhand, India
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
 



 Job Summary
 



 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced
 **Shift In\-Charge** 
 to supervise the day\-to\-day operation of a
 **Captive Power Plant** 
 . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient plant operation during the assigned shift, coordinating operating teams, monitoring equipment performance, and achieving operational targets.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Supervise complete shift operations of the power plant, including
 **Boiler, Turbine, CHP, and associated auxiliaries** 
 .
* Monitor operating parameters through
 **DCS/control room and field operations** 
 and take appropriate corrective action.
* Coordinate with Boiler, Turbine, Electrical, CHP, WTP, and Maintenance teams for smooth plant operation.
* Ensure safe start\-up, shutdown, load changes, and emergency handling as per established operating procedures.
* Monitor boiler and turbine performance and maintain stable plant load and operating conditions.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams for equipment abnormalities, breakdowns, and planned maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper coal/fuel handling and availability of required utilities during the shift.
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, generation reports, and equipment performance data.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety procedures, statutory requirements, and company operating standards.
* Supervise operators and technicians and ensure proper manpower deployment during the shift.
* Identify operational problems and coordinate troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
* Conduct shift handovers and communicate critical plant conditions and pending activities to the incoming shift team.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* **4\-5 years minimum of relevant experience** 
 in Thermal Power Plant / Captive Power Plant / Co\-Generation Plant operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **Boiler and Turbine operations** 
 .
* Experience in
 **DCS\-based plant operation** 
 will be preferred.
* Good understanding of plant auxiliaries, CHP, electrical systems, and utility systems.
* Ability to lead and coordinate shift manpower effectively.
* Strong troubleshooting, decision\-making, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of industrial safety practices and operational procedures.



 Qualification
 



**B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline.** 
 Candidates with relevant experience in captive, co\-generation, sugar, distillery, or process\-industry power plants will be considered.
 



 Immediate Requirement
 



**Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice periods will be preferred.** 




**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.** 




**Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month** 




**Benefits:** 



* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work Location: In person



  





 Apply now or send your CV to hr@impepl.com \| hr.corporate@impepl.com
